content_sections.heading: DDK Kolkata Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the category. Every category has the same age range (21 to 40 years), but the qualification and experience requirements differ. Each category lists "Essential" and, in most cases, "Desirable" requirements. Candidates must meet the essential qualification of the category they apply for. A candidate can apply for only one category. Double applications will be considered rejected. Candidates must give their consent in advance for performing assignments. Meeting the eligibility conditions does not guarantee selection. Applications go through scrutiny and screening, and Doordarshan may reject any application without assigning a reason. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and makes a candidate ineligible for selection.

content_sections.heading: DDK Kolkata Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection for DDK Kolkata empanelment follows the steps below, as described in the notice. Applications undergo scrutiny and screening. Shortlisted candidates are called for the next stage of the selection process. The selection process may consist of several steps, such as a skill test, written test or personality test, depending on the category as deemed feasible. The selection is done by a constituted selection committee. Successful candidates are invited for assignment on an "as and when required" basis. The notice does not give the exam pattern, syllabus, test dates or test venue. Empanelment confers no right to regular bookings and no right or advantage for selection to any regular post in the organisation. The decision of the Selection Committee is final and irrevocable.

content_sections.heading: DDK Kolkata Recruitment 2026: Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following terms and conditions for empanelled assignees. This is not, and will not be, an employment. Candidates will be invited for assignment strictly on an "as and when required" basis as per the day-to-day requirement of programmes at the Kendra, and their availability on the date and time of assignment. As per rules, the maximum possible number of assignments is 7 in a month and limited to 84 in a year as per programme requirement/exigencies. One assignment may take up to 2-3 days. No right is conferred to demand booking beyond the period assigned by the office. Assignees are not entitled to any fixed or specific number of bookings, as they are not on the establishment of Doordarshan. The organisation has no objection and does not restrict assignees from continuing in or taking up regular or temporary employment in any other organisation/institution, or being self-employed. Assignees have the right not to accept an assignment offered to them. Once an assignment is accepted, they are obliged to perform it. Candidates have to give their consent in advance for performing the assignment. A candidate can apply for only one category. Double applications will be considered rejected. Applications will be scrutinised, and shortlisted candidates will be called for the next stage of selection. The selection process may consist of several steps - skill test / written test / personality test - depending upon the category as deemed feasible. The selection will be done by a constituted selection committee. Bookings of empanelled candidates will be done strictly on a daily/assignment basis (not exceeding seven per month), and payment will be made as per DDK Kolkata instructions. Empanelment confers no right to be called for regular bookings, or any right/advantage for selection to any regular post in the organisation. Doordarshan reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. The decision of the Selection Committee is final and irrevocable. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will render candidates ineligible for selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Prasar Bharati (Doordarshan Kendra Kolkata) for various casual assignee positions on a contract basis for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under this notification?
faq.answer: The posts include Archive Assistant, Post Production Assistant (Graphics), Post Production Assistant (Editing), Video Assistant, Social Media Editor, C.G. Operator, Resource Person (Programme), Resource Person (Lighting Assistant), and Broadcast Assistant (Commercial).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 16 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they complete the submission before 06:00 pm on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Prasar Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts under this recruitment notification is between 21 to 40 years as per the guidelines laid out in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the application through the designated Google Form link provided by Prasar Bharati.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Archive Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Archive Assistant post must hold a Graduation degree from a recognized university with proficiency in computers (MS Excel) and fluency in Bengali and English.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the salary or stipend per assignment?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges from Rs. 2,000/- to Rs. 5,000/- per assignment depending on the specific post, with a maximum limit of 7 assignments per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the categories applying for these contract assignments.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of submitted applications followed by a skill test, written test, or personality test depending on the post requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the direct link to apply?
faq.answer: You can find the direct online application link as well as the official notification references in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
